title: Examples / Social

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023
location.note: The footer on this physical page reads Version 1.1; the book cover reads Version 1.2.

slide_intent: Keep the partner visibly responsible for a social message so viewers do not confuse it with an official IBM account.
strategic_value: Partner-led profiles and clear IBM attribution can acknowledge collaboration without borrowing IBM’s authorship.
demonstration: Twitter and LinkedIn post schematics show a green partner signature, gray content areas and subordinate IBM text or logo. The page footer reads Version1.1 within the Version1.2 book.
practical_value: Choose logo or text attribution for the available social-post space while preserving the partner’s own account identity.

content_islands.name: Twitter post
content_islands.spec: Place the vertical post schematic in the left example area with partner branding above and IBM acknowledgement below.

content_islands.name: LinkedIn post
content_islands.spec: Place the wide post schematic at right with relationship text and a partner CTA beside an image area.

content_islands.name: Scope notes
content_islands.spec: Keep the account-identity explanation below the left example and the nonexclusive-layout note at lower right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains preventing the misleading impression of an official IBM account.
reference_purposes.Application: Two platform examples show partner identity, relationship explanation and subordinate IBM presence.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Profile and background images should reflect the partner’s identity; account names must not be confusingly similar to IBM accounts. Layouts are examples, not the only permitted arrangements.
